rules.window: 97 characters, 96 overlapping pairs; leading zeros retained
rules.Fibonacci: F0=0, F1=1; full decimal terms concatenated in order; boundaries retained
rules.Euler: E(n)=n*n+n+41, starting n=0; full decimal terms concatenated in order; boundaries retained
rules.recovery: next_digit=(current_digit+r) mod11; reject digit10; ordered residues and first digit recover all digits; term boundaries require separate metadata

geometry_identity: a²+b²=8; this exact identity is independent of decimal encoding
scope: No significance test or new primality claim. Digit position does not imply equal term index across the two concatenated sequences.
